t: You're on Putney Lower Common, an open stretch of parkland in the London Borough of Wandsworth, between the town centres of Putney and Barnes. It's part of Wimbledon and Putney Commons, though it lies a mile and a half from the rest of the common. Three people are recorded as having died here. Len Braund played cricket for Surrey, Somerset and England. Hugh Orr was an Australian-born Scottish cricketer, rugby player and Royal Navy officer. George Henry Haydon was an Anglo-Australian colonial author and artist.
